notes.title: DEMO QOL Updates
notes.content:
Since the release of the demo last week I've gotten some feedback about some stuff that is hopefully addressed in this change, there is no significant game stage content modification, these are purely QOL changes that while sort of small, hopefully help a lot.

I'm still figuring lots of things out so, bear with me!
[b]
These changes will invalidate replays made before this week.[/b]

[h2]Change Notes[/h2]
- Reduced Stage 1 background noise, and changed projectile sprite in 1-2.
- Additional small encounter in 1-2 to fill up some dead space.
- Hit flashing reduced to flashing the border red exclusively.
- Death flashing reduced to flashing the border red exclusively.
- Shield does not require any lives anymore. This was unclear previously.
- Play area border will display it's behavior when the player is close to it.
- Hitbox shown after receiving damage for a few seconds.
- Player hover effect made more subtle.
- Help Menu button added.
- The 'Ask to save replay' menu defaults to NO.

Thank you for reading, I hope you to continue to support the game :)

The change should be live on both Windows and Linux.

notes.title: SOLSTORM STAGE 1 DEMO RELEASE
notes.content:
Hello, and welcome to SOLSTORM!

The playable demo for the complete first stage set of the game including the boss fight is available natively on both Windows and Linux, for you to play right now!

Additionally, [b]demo save progress will carry over to the final game![/b] Feel free to experiment and learn the games systems!

If anyone clears the demo, I would very much like to see a video or game replay of your winning run, feel free to send them at: xpostgames@gmail.com

Likewise, feel free to report any bugs using the same e-mail.

Cheers, and stay tuned for the full release!

Also, if anyone isn't connected via my social media channels please do!
